note: Derivation and numerical check only; no external data. In the fast, weak-draw limit of the shared pool, UET layer 3 is the Lotka-Volterra competition model used by Saavedra et al. (2025, SFI co-author Kempes), with the per-capita draw a_i F_i in the role of their consumption C_i and a0' = 1. What differs: one pool gives a rank-1 interaction matrix and a single winner, while Saavedra et al. assume an effective off-diagonal a0 < 1 (niche difference); UET derives mortality as 1/tau = P/F from the free-energy store. Negative control: a store not proportional to mass does not reproduce Eq. 14. Not UET-distinct for biology; it places layer 3 inside metabolic ecology.
